NOTICE OF ELECTRONIC CONSENT, MEETING AND EXTRAORDINARY RESOLUTION

THIS NOTICE IS IMPORTANT AND REQUIRES YOUR IMMEDIATE ATTENTION. This notice contains important information which should be read carefully before any decision is made with respect to the proposal set out below. If you are in doubt as to the action you should take, you are recommended to seek your own financial advice, including in respect of any tax consequences, immediately from your stockbroker, bank manager, solicitor, shari'a advisor, accountant or other independent financial adviser.  Any individual or company whose Certificates are held on its behalf by a broker, dealer, bank, custodian, trust company or other nominee must contact such entity if it wishes to vote in respect of the proposal. None of the Trustee, Estithmar, the Delegate, the Joint Dealer Managers or any of the Agents makes any recommendation as to whether or not holders of Certificates should vote in favour of the Proposal.

The distribution of this notice may be restricted by law in certain jurisdictions and persons into whose possession this notice comes are requested to inform themselves about, and to observe, any such restrictions.  The Certificates (as defined below) have not been registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act") or the securities laws of any State of the United States or any other jurisdiction and may not be offered or sold except pursuant to an exemption from registration requirements under the Securities Act. No offer or sale of securities has been or will be registered under the Securities Act or under the applicable securities laws of any other jurisdiction. There will be no public offer of the Certificates in the United States or any other jurisdiction.

Further information regarding the matters referred to in this notice is available in the Offer Memorandum (as defined below) issued by Estithmar today, and Certificateholders are encouraged to read this notice in conjunction with the same.
If you have sold or otherwise transferred your entire holding(s) of Certificates, please inform the Exchange and Tabulation Agent accordingly.
2 September 2026
Estithmar Holding Q.P.S.C.
(Incorporated in the State of Qatar)

QAR 900,000,000 Trust Certificates due September 2027 (ISIN: XS2884005047) comprising Tranche 1 (QAR 500,000,000 Trust Certificates), Tranche 2 (QAR 145,000,000 Trust Certificates), Tranche 3 (QAR 150,000,000 Trust Certificates) and Tranche 4 (QAR 105,000,000 Trust Certificates) (the "Existing Certificates") issued by Estithmar Sukuk Limited LLC (the "Trustee") under its QAR 3,400,000,000 Trust Certificate Issuance Programme
BACKGROUND

Estithmar has invited all Certificateholders (such invitation, the "Consent Solicitation") to consent by way of valid voting instructions ("Voting Instructions") or, in the case of Eligible Certificateholders, Exchange Instructions ("Exchange Instructions"), to the proposal by Estithmar (the "Proposal") for Certificateholders to approve by Extraordinary Resolution initially by way of Electronic Consent and, if the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline, at the Meeting, the modifications to the Pricing Supplements in relation to the Existing Certificates and as described in paragraph 1 of the Extraordinary Resolution below, all as further described in the Offer Memorandum dated this date and prepared by Estithmar (the "Offer Memorandum").

In conjunction with the Consent Solicitation, Estithmar is also inviting Eligible Certificateholders to offer the Existing Certificates held by them for exchange by Estithmar (the "Exchange Offer") for New Certificates (the "New Certificates"), subject to certain restrictions as more fully described in the Offer Memorandum.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that approval of the Extraordinary Resolution will first be sought by way of Electronic Consent through the Clearing Systems. If the Extraordinary Resolution is passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline, the Meeting will be cancelled. If the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline, then, pursuant to the provisions of Schedule 3 (Provisions for Meetings of Certificateholders) to the Master Trust Deed (as defined below) establishing the Programme and constituting the Existing Certificates, made between the Trustee, Estithmar and the Delegate (as defined below) as delegate for the Certificateholders (as defined below), a meeting (the "Meeting") of the Certificateholders convened by the Trustee will be held at 12:00 p.m. (London time) on 24 September 2026 at the offices of Simmons & Simmons LLP at CityPoint, One Ropemaker Street, London EC2Y 9SS, United Kingdom for the purpose of considering and, if thought fit, passing the following resolution as an Extraordinary Resolution (which requires a majority of at least 75 per cent. of the votes cast in order to be passed) in accordance with the provisions of the Master Trust Deed. If within 15 minutes (or such longer period not exceeding 30 minutes as the Chairman may decide) after that time a quorum is not present, the Meeting will (unless the Trustee and the Delegate agree otherwise) be adjourned until a date which shall be not less than 14 Clear Days and not more than 42 Clear Days later, to a place appointed by the Chairman either at or subsequent to such Meeting and approved by the Delegate.

In accordance with its normal practice, each of the Joint Dealer Managers, the Delegate, each Agent and the Exchange and Tabulation Agent expresses no view on the merits of the proposed Extraordinary Resolution.  None of the Joint Dealer Managers, the Delegate, the Agents or the Exchange and Tabulation Agent makes any representation that all relevant information has been disclosed to the Certificateholders in or pursuant to this Notice or that the information contained in this Notice is accurate or complete. Certificateholders who are in doubt as to the impact of the proposed Extraordinary Resolution are urged to seek their own independent legal, tax, accounting and financial advice.
Capitalised terms used but not defined in this Notice have the meanings given to them in the Master Trust Deed, the Conditions or the Offer Memorandum.
EXTRAORDINARY RESOLUTION
THE TERMS OF THE EXTRAORDINARY RESOLUTION ARE AS FOLLOWS:

"THAT, the holders (the "Certificateholders") of the QAR 900,000,000 in aggregate face amount of Trust Certificates due September 2027 (the "Certificates") issued by Estithmar Sukuk Limited LLC (the "Trustee") under the QAR 3,400,000,000 Trust Certificate Issuance Programme and constituted by a master trust deed dated 22 January 2024 (the "Master Trust Deed"), as supplemented by the supplemental trust deeds dated 2 September 2024, 16 December 2024, 15 October 2025 and 17 March 2026 (the "Supplemental Trust Deeds" and, together with the Master Trust Deed, the "Trust Deed") made between the Trustee, Estithmar Holding Q.P.S.C. ("Estithmar") and Citibank, N.A., London Branch (the "Delegate"), which are the subject of an agency agreement dated 22 January 2024 made between the Trustee, Estithmar, the Delegate and the Agents as defined below, by Extraordinary Resolution (as defined in the Master Trust Deed) (this "Extraordinary Resolution") passed by way of Electronic Consent or, if applicable, at the Meeting hereby RESOLVES to:

1.             assent to the amendment and restatement of each of the four pricing supplements relating to the Existing Certificates dated 28 August 2024, 12 December 2024, 13 October 2025 and 16 March 2026, respectively (each, a "Pricing Supplement" and, together, the "Pricing Supplements") such that Item 17 (Optional Dissolution Right) of each of the Pricing Supplements shall be amended by deleting the words "Not Applicable" and replacing them with the word "Applicable" such that the Optional Dissolution Right becomes applicable in respect of the Certificates together with the consequential amendments to Item 17 (Optional Dissolution Right) set out in the relevant Amended and Restated Pricing Supplements;

2.             authorise, direct, request and empower the Delegate to concur in the modifications referred to in paragraph (‎1) of this Extraordinary Resolution and, in order to give effect thereto and to implement the same, on or shortly after the passing of this Extraordinary Resolution by way of Electronic Consent or, if applicable, at the Meeting, and subject to the conditions set out below, to execute the Amended and Restated Pricing Supplements with such amendments (if any) thereto as shall be required by Estithmar and approved by the Delegate, and to concur in, and to execute and do, all such other deeds, instruments, acts and things as may be necessary, desirable or appropriate, in the sole discretion of the Delegate, to carry out and give effect to this Extraordinary Resolution and the implementation of the modifications referred to in paragraph (‎1) of this Extraordinary Resolution;

3.             sanction every abrogation, modification, variation, compromise or arrangement in respect of the rights of the Certificateholders against the Trustee or Estithmar (whether or not such rights arise under the Master Trust Deed) involved in or resulting from the Amendments or the Proposal or which are necessary to give effect to this Extraordinary Resolution;

4.             authorise, request, empower and direct the Delegate and the Agents to concur in, and to execute and do, all such other deeds, agreements, instruments, acts and things, and to take all steps as may be necessary, desirable or expedient to carry out and give effect to this Extraordinary Resolution, the execution of the Amended and Restated Pricing Supplements and the implementation of the Proposal;

5.             declare that the implementation of this Extraordinary Resolution shall be in all respects conditional on Estithmar not having previously terminated the Consent Solicitation in accordance with the provisions for such termination set out in the Offer Memorandum;

6.             discharge, release and exonerate the Delegate, each of the Agents and Citivic Nominees Pte Ltd from all liability to Certificateholders for its acts or omissions in furtherance of or in connection with this Extraordinary Resolution, the Proposal and their implementation;

7.             irrevocably waive any claim that the Certificateholders may have against the Delegate and each of the Agents arising as a result of any loss or damage which the Certificateholders may suffer or incur as a result of the Delegate or the Agents acting upon this Extraordinary Resolution (including but not limited to circumstances where it is subsequently found that this Extraordinary Resolution is not valid or binding on the Certificateholders) and confirm that the Certificateholders will not seek to hold the Delegate or the Agents liable for any such loss or damage;

8.             expressly agree and undertake to indemnify and hold harmless the Delegate and the Agents from and against all losses, liabilities, damages, costs, charges and expenses which may be suffered or incurred by them as a result of any claims (whether or not successful, compromised or settled), actions, demands or proceedings brought against the Delegate and the Agents and against all losses, costs, charges or expenses (including legal fees) which the Delegate or the Agents may suffer or incur which in any case arise as a result of the Delegate and the Agents acting in accordance with the Extraordinary Resolution, the Amended and Restated Pricing Supplements; and

9.             acknowledge that, as used in this Extraordinary Resolution, (i) "Consent Solicitation" means the invitation by Estithmar to all Certificateholders to consent to the Proposal as described in the Offer Memorandum and as the same may be amended in accordance with its terms, (ii) "Exchange Offer" means the invitation by Estithmar to all Eligible Certificateholders to offer their Existing Certificates for exchange by Estithmar as described in the Offer Memorandum and as the same may be amended in accordance with its terms; and (iii) "Proposal" means the modifications to the Pricing Supplements as described in paragraph (‎1) of this Extraordinary Resolution, all as further described in the Offer Memorandum."
In this Extraordinary Resolution:

"Amended and Restated Pricing Supplements" means the amended and restated pricing supplement in relation to the Tranche 1 Certificates, the amended and restated pricing supplement in relation to the Tranche 2 Certificates, the amended and restated pricing supplement in relation to the Tranche 3 Certificates and the amended and restated pricing supplement in relation to the Tranche 4 Certificates, each amended to implement the Proposal.
"Agents" means Citibank, N.A., London Branch in its capacities as principal paying agent, transfer agent and calculation agent and Citibank Europe Plc in its capacity as registrar.

"Clear Days" means, in relation to a period of days calculated in connection with a meeting, a period during which no account shall be taken of the day on which the notice of such meeting is given (or, in the case of an adjourned meeting, the day on which the meeting to be adjourned is held) or the day on which such meeting is held.
"Early Settlement Date" has the meaning given to it in the Offer Memorandum.
"Proposal" means the Proposal as defined in the Offer Memorandum dated 2 September 2026, as further supplemented in accordance with paragraph (1) of this Extraordinary Resolution.
"Settlement Date" has the meaning given to it in the Offer Memorandum.
Voting
A Certificateholder may in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Consent Solicitation as set out in the Offer Memorandum:
(a)           approve the Extraordinary Resolution:

(i)            by giving Electronic Consent through the Clearing Systems, either by communicating a Voting Instruction in favour of the Extraordinary Resolution or, only if it is an Eligible Certificateholder, by submitting an Exchange Instruction; or

(ii)           if the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline and the Meeting proceeds, by voting at the Meeting (in person or by proxy) or through such Voting Instruction or Exchange Instruction; or
(b)           reject the Extraordinary Resolution:
(i)            by giving Electronic Consent through the Clearing Systems by communicating a Voting Instruction against the Extraordinary Resolution; or

(ii)           if the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline and the Meeting proceeds, by voting against the Extraordinary Resolution at the Meeting (in person or by proxy) or through such Voting Instruction.
Representations of Certificateholders

Each Certificateholder giving Electronic Consent or, if applicable, attending and voting at the Meeting (whether in person, by proxy or by representative) shall be deemed to make each of the representations, warranties and undertakings set out in the sub-section entitled "Certificateholder Acknowledgement, Representations, Warranties and Undertakings - Exchange Instructions" and "Certificateholder Acknowledgement, Representations, Warranties and Undertakings - Voting Instructions", as applicable, in the section "Procedures for Participating in the Exchange Offer, the Consent Solicitation and the Proposal" of the Offer Memorandum, as if the same were set out in full herein and made at the time of such attendance and voting.
Documents Available for Inspection

Certificateholders with proof of the holding of their Certificates may, at any time with reasonable prior notice during normal business hours on any weekday (Saturdays, Sundays and bank and other public holidays excepted) prior to the Electronic Consent Results Announcement and, if applicable, during the Meeting, inspect copies of the documents set out below at https://deals.is.kroll.com/estithmar.
·              the Master Trust Deed;
·              the Supplemental Trust Deeds;
·              the Offer Memorandum;
·              the draft Amended and Restated Pricing Supplements;
·              the draft New Pricing Supplement
General

If the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline and the Meeting proceeds, the attention of Certificateholders is particularly drawn to the quorum required for the Meeting and for an adjourned Meeting which is set out in "Attendance and Quorum" below. Having regard to such requirements, Certificateholders are strongly urged either to attend the Meeting or to take steps to be represented at the Meeting, as referred to below, as soon as possible.

In accordance with its normal practice, each of the Delegate, the Joint Dealer Managers and the Agents expresses no opinion as to the merits of the Consent Solicitation, the Proposal or the Extraordinary Resolution but each of them has authorised it to be stated that, on the basis of the information as set out in the Offer Memorandum (which it recommends Certificateholders to read carefully) and in this Notice, it has no objection to the Proposal and the Extraordinary Resolution being put to Certificateholders for their consideration.  None of the Delegate, the Joint Dealer Managers or the Agents has investigated, analysed or verified the contents, objectives or any other aspect of the Proposal. None of the Delegate, the Joint Dealer Managers or the Agents has been involved in formulating or negotiating the Proposal and none of them makes any representation that all relevant information has been disclosed to the Certificateholders in or pursuant to the Offer Memorandum and the Notice of Electronic Consent and Meeting. Accordingly, Certificateholders who are unsure of the impact of the Proposal and the Extraordinary Resolution should seek their own financial, tax, accounting and legal advice.
Attendance and Quorum

The relevant provisions governing the convening and holding of the Meeting are set out in Schedule 3 (Provisions for Meetings of Certificateholders) to the Master Trust Deed, copies of which are available for inspection as referred to above.

The Certificates are currently represented by a global certificate (the "Global Certificate") held by and registered in the name of Citivic Nominees Pte Ltd as nominee for a common depositary for Euroclear and Clearstream, Luxembourg (the "Clearing Systems", and each a "Clearing System").

Certificateholders or Accountholders (directly or on behalf of Beneficial Owners) who have submitted Voting Instructions, and Eligible Certificateholders or Accountholders (directly or on behalf of Beneficial Owners) who have submitted Exchange Instructions in accordance with the procedures set out in the Offer Memorandum shall take no further action in relation to giving Electronic Consent or, if the Meeting proceeds, voting at the Meeting in respect of the Extraordinary Resolution. By submitting or delivering a duly completed Voting Instruction or, in the case of an Eligible Certificateholder only, an Exchange Instruction to the relevant Clearing Systems, the relevant Certificateholder or Accountholder (directly or on behalf of the relevant Beneficial Owner) irrevocably gives Electronic Consent in accordance with such instruction and, if the Meeting proceeds, irrevocably instructs the Principal Paying Agent to appoint one or more representatives of the Exchange and Tabulation Agent nominated by it as proxies. A Voting Instruction may direct such proxy to vote in favour of or against the Extraordinary Resolution. An Exchange Instruction shall constitute an Electronic Consent in favour of the Extraordinary Resolution and, if the Meeting proceeds, an instruction to vote in favour of the Extraordinary Resolution at the Meeting.

If the Meeting proceeds, Certificateholders who wish to attend and vote at the Meeting, or appoint a proxy or representative to do so, must not submit a Voting Instruction or, in the case of Eligible Certificateholders, an Exchange Instruction in respect of the relevant Existing Certificates.

The following paragraphs (1)-(2) apply only to holders of Certificates in definitive form who have not submitted or delivered or arranged for the submission or delivery of Exchange Instructions or Voting Instructions to the relevant Clearing System in accordance with the terms of the Offer Memorandum.

(1)           A holder of Certificates in definitive form and not in an account with any Clearing System may, by an instrument in writing in the English language (a "form of proxy") signed by the holder or, in the case of a corporation, executed under its common seal or signed on its behalf by an attorney or a duly authorised officer of the corporation and delivered to the specified office of the Registrar or any Transfer Agent not less than 24 hours before the time fixed for the relevant meeting, appoint any person (a "proxy") to act on his or its behalf in connection with any meeting of the Certificateholders and any adjourned such meeting.

(2)           Any proxy appointed pursuant to paragraphs (1) above shall so long as such appointment remains in force be deemed, for all purposes in connection with the Meeting, to be the Certificateholder to which such appointment relates and the Certificateholder shall be deemed for such purposes not to be the holder.

Beneficial Owners and Accountholders who hold their interest in Certificates through a Clearing System and who wish to attend and vote at the Meeting (or any adjourned Meeting) in person should contact the relevant Clearing System to make arrangements to procure a Voting Certificate (as defined in the Master Trust Deed and in accordance with the terms set out therein) in respect of the Certificates in which they have an interest for the purposes of attending and voting at the Meeting (or any adjourned such Meeting).

If the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent and the Meeting proceeds, the Extraordinary Resolution may only be considered at the Meeting if the Meeting is quorate. The Meeting will be quorate if one or more Eligible Persons are present and holding or representing the requisite face amount of outstanding Existing Certificates for the quorum requirement (as set out below across from "Original Meeting").  If the Meeting is not quorate, it will (unless the Trustee and the Delegate agree otherwise) be adjourned to a later time and date. When the Meeting resumes following adjournment, the Master Trust Deed makes provision for a lower quorum requirement (as set out below across from "Adjourned Meeting").

If within 15 minutes after the time initially fixed for the Meeting, a quorum is not present, the Meeting shall stand adjourned until a date which shall be not less than 14 Clear Days and not more than 42 Clear Days later, to a place appointed by the Chairman and approved by the Delegate. Notice of such adjourned Meeting shall be given to Certificateholders not less than 10 Clear Days before the date fixed for the adjourned Meeting. If a quorum is not present within 15 minutes (or such longer period not exceeding 30 minutes as the Chairman may decide) from the time fixed for a meeting so adjourned, the Chairman may, with the approval of the Delegate, either dissolve the meeting or adjourn it again for not less than 14 Clear Days, to a place appointed by the Chairman and approved by the Delegate.

Valid Exchange Instructions and Voting Instructions delivered and (if revocable) not revoked prior to the Electronic Consent Deadline shall be counted for the purposes of the Electronic Consent. If the Extraordinary Resolution is not passed by way of Electronic Consent by the Electronic Consent Deadline and the Meeting proceeds, such Exchange Instructions and Voting Instructions shall remain valid for the Meeting and any adjourned Meeting without any requirement to resubmit such Exchange Instructions or Voting Instructions. If the Meeting is adjourned, Voting Instructions voting against the Extraordinary Resolution may thereafter be amended or revoked on or before the Adjournment Deadline. If the Meeting is adjourned, Certificateholders who have not already submitted Voting Instructions on or prior to the Final Deadline may submit Voting Instructions during the period commencing at the conclusion of the original Meeting and ending on the Adjournment Deadline.
The quorum requirements are as follows:
Meeting
Quorum Requirement
Original Meeting
One or more Eligible Persons present and holding or representing in aggregate not less than 75 per cent. of the face amount of the Existing Certificates for the time being outstanding.
Adjourned Meeting
One or more Eligible Persons present and holding or representing in aggregate not less than 25 per cent. of the face amount of the Existing Certificates for the time being outstanding.

Each question submitted to a Meeting shall be decided by a show of hands unless a poll is (before, or on the declaration of the result of, the show of hands) demanded by any of the chairman, the Trustee, Estithmar, the Delegate or any Eligible Person.

On a show of hands every Eligible Person who is present shall have one vote. On a poll every Eligible Person who is so present shall have one vote in respect of each QAR 1 (or such other amount as the Delegate may in its absolute discretion stipulate) in face amount of Certificates held or owned or represented by such Eligible Person. Without prejudice to the obligations of the proxies named in any Block Voting Instruction or form of proxy, any Eligible Person entitled to more than one vote need not use all his or her votes or cast all the votes to which he or she is entitled in the same way.
Votes in favour of the Extraordinary Resolution must represent at least 75 per cent. of the votes cast for the Extraordinary Resolution to be duly passed.

If passed by way of Electronic Consent or, if applicable, at the Meeting (or any adjourned Meeting), the Extraordinary Resolution will be binding upon all Certificateholders, whether or not they gave Electronic Consent, were present or represented at the Meeting and whether or not they voted at the Meeting.
This notice is governed by, and shall be construed in accordance with, English law.
